fields.label: Worker
fields.description: Choose the worker profile. A worker does not need a user login to earn dehadi.

fields.label: Billing Terms
fields.description: Select the billing agreement for this project. It decides whether client revenue is daily or fixed.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: The work location for this allocation. It must belong to the selected project.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: First date this allocation can be used for attendance. Create a new dated allocation when agreed rates change.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Optional last attendance date for this allocation; leave blank while it remains active.

fields.label: Daily Worker Wage
fields.description: Amount the worker earns for one full day. A half-day earns half this amount. Earnings are separate from wages paid.

fields.label: Client Rate per Worker-Day
fields.description: Amount charged to the client for one full worker-day under Daily billing. Fixed contracts earn client revenue through milestones instead.
